# features=smooth,de words=1 word=float32 rn=False fastmath=False
import math

import numpy as np
from numba_cuda_mlir import cuda
from numba_cuda_mlir.cuda import libdevice as ld

FT = np.float32
F32 = np.float32
U32 = np.uint32
TWO = FT(2.0)
ONE = FT(1.0)
ZERO = FT(0.0)
BAIL = FT(1e6)
Z32 = F32(0.0)
ONE32 = F32(1.0)
HALF32 = F32(0.5)
BIG32 = F32(3.0e38)
DENS32 = F32(5.0)
TRAPX = F32(0.25)
TRAPY = F32(0.1)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_add(a, b):
    return a + b


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sub(a, b):
    return a - b


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul(a, b):
    return a * b


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sqr(a):
    return a * a


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul2(a):
    return TWO * a


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_from(a):
    return a


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def c_mul(ar_0, ai_0, br_0, bi_0):
    xr_0 = w_mul(ar_0, br_0)
    yr_0 = w_mul(ai_0, bi_0)
    rr_0 = w_sub(xr_0, yr_0)
    xi_0 = w_mul(ar_0, bi_0)
    yi_0 = w_mul(ai_0, br_0)
    ri_0 = w_add(xi_0, yi_0)
    return (rr_0, ri_0)


@cuda.jit(fastmath=False)
def k_f32_B(c0r_0, c0i_0, dx, max_iter, row0, out_f, out_u):
    x, y = cuda.grid(2)
    h = out_u.shape[1]
    w = out_u.shape[2]
    yy = y + row0
    if x < w and yy < h:
        ox = FT(x - w // 2)
        oy = FT(h // 2 - yy)
        pr_0 = w_from(ox * dx)
        pi_0 = w_from(oy * dx)
        cr_0 = w_add(c0r_0, pr_0)
        ci_0 = w_add(c0i_0, pi_0)
        zr_0 = w_from(ZERO)
        zi_0 = w_from(ZERO)
        dr_0 = w_from(ZERO)
        di_0 = w_from(ZERO)
        one_0 = w_from(ONE)
        r2 = ZERO
        n = 0
        while n < max_iter:
            x2_0 = w_sqr(zr_0)
            y2_0 = w_sqr(zi_0)
            r2 = x2_0 + y2_0
            if r2 > BAIL:
                break
            er_0, ei_0 = c_mul(zr_0, zi_0, dr_0, di_0)
            t2_0 = w_mul2(er_0)
            dr_0 = w_add(t2_0, one_0)
            di_0 = w_mul2(ei_0)
            m_0 = w_mul(zr_0, zi_0)
            m2_0 = w_mul2(m_0)
            q_0 = w_sub(x2_0, y2_0)
            zr_0 = w_add(q_0, cr_0)
            zi_0 = w_add(m2_0, ci_0)
            n += 1
        out_u[0, yy, x] = n
        if n < max_iter:
            fr = F32(r2)
            lz = HALF32 * math.log(fr)
            out_f[0, yy, x] = F32(n) + ONE32 - math.log2(lz)
            dz2 = F32(dr_0 * dr_0 + di_0 * di_0)
            out_f[1, yy, x] = math.sqrt(fr) * lz / math.sqrt(dz2)
